preparation.operation: Use the established native magenta hue key and spill removal; discard alpha below 24, crop to visible alpha bounds, and add two transparent pixels on each side without resizing.

review.notes: Prepared asset inspection on charcoal ground confirms two posts, five inner uprights, two connecting rails and clear transparent gaps without magenta spill. Formal acceptance requires composed-screen review at gameplay scale.
